notes.title: Whatever Demo on Steam Next Fest June 2022!
notes.content:
Whatever Demo on Steam Next Fest June 2022!
Dare to drift the giant cargo ship in our brand-new demo if you can. 

Check out the trailer: https://bit.ly/3MNwby9

Whatever is a top-down isometric meme racing game inspired by true events. Have you ever wondered how hard it is drifting the giant cargo ship through the tiny canal? Even if not, the game is much more than just a meme gone wild. It has controller support. And BOSSES!
The game is scheduled to release on PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One/Series S/X in Q4 2022.

Social media:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/f2d2VGxqTh
Twitter: https://mobile.twitter.com/thegamewhatever

Play the demo, stream the demo, and put a hashtag #StuckWhatever. The funniest video will end up in our Steam Next Fest video compilation!

Don't get stuck!
